description: Land Acquisition - Compensations for the acquisitions of the Lands in D/S Division, Weerambugedara, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under The Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (names, plan numbers, lot numbers, extents, and boundaries) and notifications about compensation deposits for land acquisition. This fits the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
